entries.description:
Qi Modulation
Jingran switches between the Yin Vessel and Yang Font states by casting Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander. Jingran is in the Yang Font state by default.
Heavy Attack - Soul Raid
When Jingran holds 300 points of Qi while in the Yin Vessel state, hold Normal Attack to consume 300 of Qi to cast Heavy Attack - Soul Raid, dealing Fusion DMG.
After casting Heavy Attack - Soul Raid, Jingran switches to the Yang Font state.
or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 2.
Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander
When Jingran holds 300 points of Qi while in the Yang Font state, hold Normal Attack to consume 300 of Qi to cast Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander, dealing Fusion DMG.
After casting Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander, Jingran switches to the Yin Vessel state.
or hold Normal Attack shortly after casting this skill to cast Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 2.
Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander can be cast in mid-air.
Qi
Max 300 points.
- Casting Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 3, Basic Attack - Drink Soul Stage 4, Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 3, or Basic Attack - Devil's Bane Stage 4 restores 50 of Qi.
- Casting Dodge Counter - Nether Dive, Dodge Counter - Light Watch, Resonance Skill - Netherworld Traverse, Resonance Skill - Afterlife's Guide, or Intro Skill - Question the Tombs restores 100 of Qi.
- Casting Resonance Liberation - Burial of Thousand Souls or casting Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander with Wayfarer's Mark restores 200 of Qi.
Fire of Life
Max 100 points.
- Casting Resonance Liberation - Burial of Thousand Souls grants 100 of Fire of Life.
- All Fire of Life is cleared when Yinghuo ends.
While in Yinghuo, if Fire of Life is not at 0, casting Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander consumes 25 of Fire of Life, and the DMG Multiplier of this Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander is increased based on Jingran's Max HP: The DMG Multiplier of this Heavy Attack - Soul Raid or Heavy Attack - Stardome Meander is increased for every 1000 of Jingran's Max HP over 25000. Up to 25000 points of Jingran's Max HP count towards this effect.
Nether to Light
- Jingran's DEF is fixed at 0.
- Jingran gains Incoming Healing Bonus based on Max HP: For every 1000 of Max HP, Jingran receives 6.2% Incoming Healing Bonus, up to 310%.
- Jingran gains Fusion DMG Bonus based on Max HP: For every 1000 of Max HP, Jingran receives 1.5% Fusion DMG Bonus, up to 75%.
Yang Changes, Yin Unites
Jingran gains additional ATK based on Max HP: For every 1000 of Max HP, Jingran gains 36 additional ATK, up to 1800.

entries.text:
Targets take 40% more Heavy Attack DMG from Jingran.
The DMG Multiplier of Chimei Wangliang is increased by 80%.
Upon entering the Yinghuo state, Jingran gains the Parade of Thousand Souls effect for 15s. During this effect, if Jingran is the active Resonator in the team, upon dealing damage, Jingran summons Chimei Wangliang to attack the targets, dealing Fusion DMG, considered Heavy Attack DMG.
Chimei Wangliang can be summoned this way at an interval of 1s for up to 8 times. Parade of Thousand Souls ends and the available summon charges of Chimei Wangliang reset when either of the following conditions is met:
- Cast Resonance Liberation - Burial of Thousand Souls.
- Yinghuo ends or is removed.
